comment: F12 — within ONE brand, same-story repetition must decay CTR faster than story rotation. Both arms run TWO creatives at identical reach, so asset-level wearout (exposures_72h) is matched and cannot explain a difference. The only thing that differs is whether the two creatives share a claimed CONCEPT: 2000001 and 2000003 both claim ECO_FRIENDLY (same story, different asset) while 2000001 and 2000002 are disjoint (eco/recycled vs cushioning/comfort/washable/style). brand_semantic_fatigue is retrieved from past SAWs sharing a concept with the stimulus and excludes the stimulus itself, so this pairing isolates that channel exactly. SIZED 2026-08-20: 300x16 at 0.5 reach on two creatives gives ~240 clicks per arm, ~120 per half-run — enough for a half-vs-half decay comparison to mean something.
